description: Reverse-ETL e-signature activation: create (and, by default, send) a PandaDoc document from a template for each row of an upstream DataFrame (`POST /documents` with template_uuid + recipients + tokens, then poll to `document.draft` and `POST /documents/{id}/send`). Creates REAL documents and, by default, immediately emails a signature request the moment this asset materializes.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one PandaDoc document created from a template, personalized via tokens_map / name_template.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (documents_created / documents_failed / rows_skipped_no_recipient / first_document_ids). No downstream data -- the side effect is a real PandaDoc document + (with auto_send) a signature-request email.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

template_uuid.label: Template UUID
template_uuid.description: PandaDoc template UUID the document is built from.

recipient_email_column.label: Recipient Email Column
recipient_email_column.description: Upstream column holding the recipient's email address.

recipient_first_name_column.description: Upstream column holding the recipient's first name.
recipient_first_name_column.label: Recipient First Name Column

recipient_last_name_column.description: Upstream column holding the recipient's last name.
recipient_last_name_column.label: Recipient Last Name Column

recipient_role.label: Recipient Role
recipient_role.description: Template recipient role name to assign this recipient to.

tokens_map.label: Tokens Map
tokens_map.description: Upstream column -> PandaDoc template token name, to prefill from row values.

auto_send.label: Auto Send
auto_send.description: Poll until sendable and send immediately, vs. create-only.

send_message.description: Optional message included in the send-notification email (auto_send mode only).
send_message.label: Send Message

poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between document-status polls while waiting for 'document.draft' (auto_send mode only).
poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds

poll_timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the document to reach 'document.draft' before failing that row (auto_send mode only).
poll_timeout_seconds.label: Poll Timeout Seconds

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (blast-radius safety cap, not a rate limit).

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily' / 'weekly' / 'monthly' / 'hourly' / 'static' / 'multi' / 'dynamic' / None. A partitioned run sends only the rows in its partition (see partition_date_column / partition_static_column).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.

partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter the rows to send to the current date partition key.
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter the rows to send to the current static partition value.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

name: PandaDoc Document Create
